question: Q1
comment: Summary section at the top gives 'Tests: 54 (30 passed, 24 failed)' at once. The main problem (locator failures) is not stated there; I had to scroll to Failure analysis to see it.

question: Q2
comment: Each failure shows category, confidence, cause, cluster, a screenshot with alt text, and links to log and DOM snapshot. The pasted traceback includes raw object reprs (ShopPage object at 0x...), which is noisy.

question: Q3
comment: Locator failures give a concrete next step: run with --heal and review the proposed locator, or update the locator in the page object. The same text repeats for every failure in a cluster.

question: Q4
comment: Provider is labelled mock and each metric has a Basis column. But 'Healing success rate 5.0%' counts steps with a proposed locator, not verified repairs, and 'API cost per run' divides by 2 runs for a single report, so a reader could misread them.

question: Q5
comment: Static check only, keyboard and 200% zoom not yet tested by me: lang attribute, table headers, alt text on screenshots, status written as PASSED/FAILED. No ARIA attributes and no responsive rules.

question: Q1
comment: Latest-run tiles (pass rate 55.6%, coverage, executability) are the first thing on the page. Passed/failed counts appear only in the run table, and no main problem is stated.

question: Q2
comment: No failure causes, screenshots or logs, and no link to the run report. Understandable because the Dashboard is a summary view, but I would have to open the report to understand any failure.

question: Q3
comment: No next steps anywhere on the page. It shows figures and trends only; actions live in the report.

question: Q4
comment: 'How each number is counted' is listed on the page and it states that mock-provider figures describe the pipeline, not model quality. Runs 1 and 2 show identical latency (773 ms), which suggests shared source data and is not explained.

question: Q5
